cells.connection_model: single shared connection with backend write lock
cells.schema_note: SqliteBackend.transactional() acquires a single asyncio.Lock + BEGIN IMMEDIATE connection, so all writes serialize through one path. Concurrency > 1 measures how many tasks queue at the lock, not parallel SQLite writes.
